title: Beginner Glute Cable Routine
author: Yasmin C.
desc: A beginner-friendly lower-body workout that uses the cable machine to build and shape the glutes and hamstrings. It opens with a stair climber warm-up, moves through sumo squats, cable Romanian deadlifts, glute kickbacks, and cable crossovers, then finishes with a longer stair climber session for a cardio and glute burn. Cables keep steady tension on the muscles through every rep, so you can focus on form and the mind-muscle connection while building a foundation you can progress from.
